sentences.text: It is submitted that the lands of the petitioners have been acquired for the purpose of respondent no.3/Karnataka Industrial Areas Development Board.
The present writ petition is filed with a prayer to quash the notifications in respect of acquisition of the said lands.

However, in the course of the arguments, the learned counsel for the petitioners submits that, during pendency of the writ petition, the petitioners have made a representation to respondent nos.2 and 3 to grant them an alternative land taking into consideration the value of the lands of the petitioners acquired including malkis standing thereon in lieu of monetary compensation.

2. The learned counsel for respondent nos.3 and 4 submits that the case of the petitioners will be considered in accordance with law as per the policy of the Government and they will be allotted alternative developed land as per the policy of the Government.
He further submits that the request of the petitioners to allot the alternative land in the same survey number will also be considered, if possible.
His submission is placed on record.

Hence, the following:
NC: 2024:KHC:32568 ORDER The writ petition is disposed of in terms of the undertaking given by the learned counsel for respondent nos.3 and 4.
The said exercise shall be completed within a period of eight weeks from the date of receipt of a certified copy of this order.
Pending I.As., if any, stand disposed of.

Sd/-
(M.I.ARUN) JUDGE hkh.
